properties.note: Visible maintained central fairway extent in the 2019 dormant-season orthophoto, following the bend from the northwestern landing area toward the eastern green. The low-contrast apron beside the greenside bunkers is left outside this trace. The public summer map view corroborated identity and gross mowing pattern only; every adopted vertex is measured in the retained 2019 source image. Current mowing, recent alterations and absolute registration remain unverified.

Observed central maintained fairway patch east of the western green; dormant-season contrast makes some edge turns interpretive. The shaded western approach beside trees is left untraced because its 2019 edge cannot be followed reliably. The polygon excludes the green, woodland and the separate southern hole. It does not extend toward the tee by route buffering. Public summer imagery corroborated which short-grass strip belongs to this route; all vertices retain the 2019 source-pixel positions.
Visible sand footprint southeast of green10, replacing the OSM bunker displaced southwest onto the fairway. The larger light-soil surrounding bank is excluded.
Visible western fairway sand footprint; guide4 corroborates the bunker on the left of the approach, with98m distance annotation.
Visible eastern fairway sand footprint; guide4 corroborates the bunker on the right of the approach, with147m distance annotation.
Visible sand/water footprint east of green5. Surrounding bare-soil apron and drain depression north of it are excluded; guide5 corroborates greenside bunker identity.
Visible gray sand footprint left of fairway5 in north-up imagery; adjacent hole8 lies farther west. Current guide corroborates this side bunker.
Visible northern approach bunker east of hole7 fairway, before the greenside pair.
Visible southern approach bunker northeast of hole7 pond.
Visible gray sand footprint on the eastern edge of the middle hole10 fairway, north of the smaller pair.
Visible middle sand footprint in the fairway10 eastern bunker group.
Visible southern small sand footprint in the fairway10 eastern bunker group.
Visible approach bunker southwest of green12, separate from the previously mapped bunker immediately west of the green.
Visible northern sand footprint near the hole14 fairway approach; bare-soil surroundings are not adopted.
Visible southern sand footprint near the hole14 fairway approach.
Main rear platform; white/yellow at rear and blue forward.
Separate forward red/orange platform south of crossing path, omitted by previous model.
White tee northwest of the path; old main pad association moved to a non-tee area.
Small yellow platform partly shaded by tree.
Additional physical long platform beside path, no current colour assignment in guide.
Blue/red shared platform south of crossing path; previously missing.
Small forward orange platform beside fairway and eastern path; previously missing.
Rear white platform east of pond.
Middle yellow platform, edge differs from coarse OSM.
Forward blue/red/orange platform with distinguishable mown edge.
Rear white platform; mow edge inset from historical outline.
Long yellow/blue platform; trace current inner maintained edge, not slope apron.
Forward red platform inside path bend.
Orange H4 shares the clearly bounded H2 white platform southwest of the H4 fairway tip. Full guide topology and native imagery independently corroborate the shared deck.
Main white/yellow/blue platform. Tree shadow conceals the northeast edge; conservative visible maintained portion only.
Red/orange platform west of path, missing from old model.
Rear white platform northwest of the path bend. Mown perimeter is visible beside the trees; the 2019 model omitted this distinct platform.
Long yellow platform southwest of the path bend. Latest turf edge replaces the old diagonal platform shape that crossed its western rough bank.
Round blue/red platform below the path, before the small pond. Both colour starts share this physical platform in the guide.
Small rectangular orange platform between the path and pond. Mowing/sod rectangle is visible independently of the guide.
Long rear platform shared by white/yellow/blue. Bright and shaded turf edges traced from the native image; southern edge near tree shadows has greater uncertainty.
Separate red oval southwest of the paved path. The current source perimeter is tighter than the retained OSM ring.
Forward orange rectangular turf/sod platform west of red, clearly bounded in 2025. This was absent from the inherited two-platform model.

Conservative visible mown portion of the separate rear white platform. Tree shadow and canopy obscure the full perimeter, especially its east/south edge; this does not assert the concealed platform extent.

Elongated yellow/blue maintained platform. Visible mowing boundary and surface continue through tree shadow; west/south vegetation obscures parts of the edge, so uncertainty exceeds that of open platforms.

Conservative visible western turf of the red platform east of the path junction. Dense shadow/canopy conceals its eastern edge; full platform extent remains unresolved and the OSM outline is not promoted to image precision.
Clear small rectangular orange platform north of the path bend, west of green7. Sod/mowing boundaries visible in the latest image; newly restored physical platform.
Separate rear white platform south of the road and north of the cart path bend. The previous model omitted this physical platform and placed white on the yellow/blue pad.

Long yellow/blue platform below the roadside pavement. The southern edge is partly shaded. Bare patch inside the turf is retained as part of the physical platform, not interpreted as an independent deck.
Western forward oval shared by red and orange. Image perimeter follows current maintained turf, with the rough bank excluded.
Small rear white platform west of the path. Tree shadow obscures part of eastern and southern mowing edge; guide establishes platform identity.
Long yellow/blue platform east of winding path. Native mowing edge traced independently; north end is blue group in guide.
Forward red platform near path and small building. Southeast mowing edge partly shaded.
Rear rounded rectangular platform shared by white/yellow/blue. Distinct rough strip separates it from red platform to north.
Separate short oval red platform north of rear platform. Existing combined polygon joined the two incorrectly.
Triangular main white/yellow/blue tee west of the adjacent green. Guide colours share this platform.
Separate circular red platform east of adjacent green, with a clear mowing edge and approach path. Missing from old hole pads.
Small rear white platform beside road; edge is fully visible.
Separate yellow/blue platform northwest of rear white platform; southern edge partly shaded. Missing from old hole pads.
Separate forward red platform near rough neck; clear rounded mowing island. Missing from old hole pads.
Long curved white/yellow/blue tee; follows native inner mowing edge, not expanded surrounding apron.
Separate forward red platform south of path; clear rounded mowing edge. Missing from old hole pads.
Rear roadside white platform, also serving guide white start for hole 17. Eastern half partly under tree shadow; shared ring traced once.
Long slender yellow/blue platform beside road; native closely mown inner surface, separate from surrounding wider apron.
Red platform between main tee and northern path junction; native mowing boundary traced.
Small rear white platform heavily shaded along east/south edges; guide locates the platform. Increased interpretation uncertainty.
Curved main yellow/blue platform west of path; inner closely mown turf boundary visible.
Separate forward red platform east of path. Eastern edge under shadow.
White tee shares the roadside physical platform with hole 15 white, confirmed by guide compass and relative platform grouping. Exact same EPSG:3006 trace reused.
Yellow/blue rectangular island south of path. Previous model incorrectly used it as white start.
Separate forward red tee south of path and southeast of the range tee strips.
Small rear white platform north of the path in tree shade. Native boundary visible on western edge; guide identifies rear platform.
Main yellow/blue platform at path bend; closed mowing edge fully visible.
Separate forward red platform south of path; lower boundary partly shaded. Missing from old hole pads.
